caption: The video captures a person wearing a white short-sleeved shirt in a push-up posture on a glossy red-and-green mosaic tiled floor. Strong sunlight from a barred window behind creates a bright lens flare that washes out the head and upper torso. A door sits at the left, a metal bench or rack sits at the right, and the camera remains fixed. The person's hands stay planted flat on the tiles, fingers spread, while hanging plants occupy the upper corner. Within the excerpt, the body lowers from a more extended-arm position toward the floor as the elbows bend. The descent brings the chest and head close to the tiles, leaving the arms bent and the torso held low. After holding this position for a moment, the person begins to rise, extending the arms to lift the torso slightly off the ground. The lower body and feet remain outside the frame, confining the visible action to the upper body and planted hands.
relations: Bending elbows lower the torso toward the floor while planted hands maintain support on the glossy tiles.
The descent brings the chest close to the ground as the arms remain bent to hold the low position.
Extending the arms after the hold lifts the torso slightly, keeping the hands planted and the camera fixed.
Strong sunlight from the barred window continues to wash out the head and upper torso throughout the movement.
